description: This file defines an internal interface ICommandInterceptor intended for intercepting database commands within various Orleans ADO.NET storage components, conditional on different compilation symbols for specific storage or clustering features.

classes.name: ICommandInterceptor
classes.description: An internal interface providing a method to intercept and possibly modify or handle database commands (IDbCommand).

methods.name: Intercept
methods.description: A method to intercept an IDbCommand, possibly for logging, modification, or other pre-processing.
